authority: Curated development requirement records, checked against corpus statements by the implementing agent. Not independently reviewed or a complete semantic model.

family.question: These candidates describe different tasks. Which task do you mean?

values.pair: Find two positions whose values total a target
values.houses: Choose nonadjacent houses for maximum cash
values.land: Measure land in a binary grid
values.rank: Rank or select values by magnitude
values.window: Find a consecutive slice with a sum objective

indexing.question: These pair problems differ in output indexing. Where do positions start?

ordering.question: What ordering is guaranteed for the input?

layout.question: These house problems differ in adjacency. How are the houses connected?

values.line: Straight line; the ends do not touch
values.circle: Circle; the first and last houses are neighbors
values.tree: Binary tree; parent and child are neighbors

transactions.question: These stock problems differ in the allowed number of completed trades. What is the limit?

values.k: At most an input parameter k

values.per_trade: An input fee charged once per completed trade

cooldown.question: Must you wait after selling before buying again?

values.one_day: Wait the next day after a sale

output.question: These candidates differ in what they return. Which output do you need?

values.possible: Whether all courses can be completed
values.order: Any valid ordering of every course
values.area: Area of the largest land component
values.square: Area of the largest square with an all-land border
values.frequent: The k most frequent distinct integer values
values.third: Third distinct maximum, or maximum if fewer than three
values.ranks: A rank for every input value
values.length: Minimum qualifying slice length, or zero

changes.question: These grid problems differ in allowed changes. May a water cell become land?

values.one_flip: Change at most one zero to one

updates.question: Is this one fixed input or a stream that keeps receiving values?

values.stream: Maintain a value after each insertion

duplicates.question: How should duplicate values affect ranking?

values.shared_rank: Equal values receive the same rank

profiles.title: Two Sum
profiles.contract: Exactly one pair of different positions in an integer array totals the target. Return zero-based positions in either order; never reuse a position.

profiles.title: Two Sum II
profiles.contract: Nondecreasing integer input, exactly one pair of distinct positions totaling the target. Return increasing one-based positions using constant extra space.

profiles.title: House Robber
profiles.contract: Nonnegative cash on a straight line of houses. Maximize total cash without choosing adjacent houses. Return the amount, not the chosen houses.

profiles.title: House Robber II
profiles.contract: Nonnegative cash on a circle of houses; the ends are neighbors. Maximize cash without adjacent selections. A single house can be selected. Return the amount.

profiles.title: House Robber III
profiles.contract: Nonnegative cash on a binary tree. Never select both endpoints of a parent-child edge. Return maximum total cash.

profiles.title: Stock: one trade
profiles.contract: Buy once and sell on a later day, or do nothing. No short selling. Return maximum profit, with zero when no profitable trade exists.

profiles.title: Stock: repeated trades
profiles.contract: Unlimited transactions, at most one share held. Same-day buy/sell is allowed. No fees or cooldown. Return maximum total profit; doing nothing is allowed.

profiles.title: Stock: two trades
profiles.contract: At most two completed trades, holding at most one share at a time. No fee or cooldown. Return maximum total profit; doing nothing is allowed.

profiles.title: Stock: k trades
profiles.contract: An input k limits completed trades. Hold at most one share. No fees or cooldown. Return maximum total profit; doing nothing is allowed.

profiles.title: Stock: transaction fee
profiles.contract: Unlimited trades, at most one share held. Charge the input fee once per completed buy/sell. No cooldown. Return maximum net profit; doing nothing is allowed.

profiles.title: Stock: cooldown
profiles.contract: Unlimited trades, at most one share held. After a sale, the next day cannot contain a buy. No transaction fee. Return maximum profit; doing nothing is allowed.

profiles.title: Course Schedule
profiles.contract: Courses are labeled zero to n-1. Pair [a,b] requires b before a. Return whether every course can be completed, not an ordering or semester count.

profiles.title: Course Schedule II
profiles.contract: Courses are labeled zero to n-1. Pair [a,b] requires b before a. Return any valid ordering containing all courses; return an empty list if impossible.

profiles.title: Number of Islands
profiles.contract: Rectangular character grid '0'/'1', water outside, horizontal/vertical connections only. Return the number of separate land components without adding land.

profiles.title: Max Area of Island
profiles.contract: Rectangular integer zero/one grid, four-directional connections and water outside. Return the largest component's cell count, or zero when empty. Do not add land.

profiles.title: Making A Large Island
profiles.contract: Square binary grid. Change at most one zero to one, then return the largest four-directionally connected island's area.

profiles.title: Largest 1-Bordered Square
profiles.contract: Binary grid. Return the full area of the largest square subgrid whose entire border is ones; its interior can contain zeros. Return zero if none exists.

profiles.title: Top K Frequent Elements
profiles.contract: Integer array and valid positive k. Return the k distinct values with highest frequencies, in any order; the answer set is unique. Do better than O(n log n).

profiles.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
profiles.contract: Integer array and valid positive k. Return the kth largest value, counting duplicates separately. The follow-up asks for a solution without sorting.

profiles.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
profiles.contract: Initialize with k and an integer array. Each add(value) inserts into persistent state and returns the kth largest occurrence so far, counting duplicates separately.

profiles.title: Third Maximum Number
profiles.contract: Return the third distinct largest integer; if fewer than three distinct values exist, return the maximum instead.

profiles.title: Rank Transform of an Array
profiles.contract: Return an array replacing each integer with its ascending dense rank starting at one. Equal values share ranks, with no gaps between distinct ranks.

profiles.title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
profiles.contract: Positive integer array and positive target. Return the minimum length of a contiguous slice with sum at least the target, or zero if none exists.

profiles.title: Maximum Subarray
profiles.contract: Nonempty integer array, including possible negatives. Return the largest sum of a nonempty contiguous slice. No deletions or circular wraparound.
